subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Animals especially on a farm, regarded as an asset.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Livestock."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Livestock"** refers to animals, especially those raised on a farm, that are kept for their use or value. (जानवर, विशेष रूप से खेत में पाले गए जानवर, जिन्हें उनके उपयोग या मूल्य के लिए रखा जाता है)
 
• It is a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**: *The farmer had a large herd of **livestock**__, including cows, pigs, and sheep.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Livid (Option 1)** means extremely angry or furious. (क्रोधित)
 
• **Livery stable (Option 2) **refers to a stable where horses are kept for hire or boarding. (एक अस्तबल जहाँ घोड़ों को किराये या भोजन के लिए रखा जाता है।

 आजीविका (विकल्प 3) का अर्थ है स्वयं का समर्थन करने का एक साधन, आमतौर पर रोजगार के माध्यम से)
 
• **Livelihood (Option 3)** means a means of supporting oneself, usually through employment or business. (धन अर्जित करने का ढंग; आजीविका, रोज़ी)
